item.title: Exact Headline for Coffee Post

turns.text: Make a square social image with a steaming espresso on a sunny café table. Headline: “Small cup. Big energy.” Warm and simple, no other text.

item.tests: Checks that a supplied headline appears verbatim and legibly in a finished social image.

answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social image; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Visual style and mood: Warm, simple, sunny café scene with a steaming espresso.

must_haves: One square finished image is delivered.
The headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” including punctuation.
The headline is clearly readable against the background and is not clipped.
A steaming espresso sits on a sunlit café table.

turns.text: Could you make an image with a steaming espresso sitting on a sunny café table? I always like that little moment of anticipation before the first sip, so that is why this idea appealed to me. What I mean is a square social image, with the headline exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” I sometimes worry that a small idea like this will get lost when I try to explain it. Please keep the overall feeling warm and simple, and don’t include any other text.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a warm, simple square social image: a freshly poured espresso in a small ivory ceramic cup on a matching saucer, sitting untouched on a sunny café table. Delicate visible curls of steam catch the golden sunlight, conveying the quiet anticipation just before the first sip. Natural photographic still life, warm cream and honey tones, soft shadows, uncluttered composition with ample negative space above the cup. Include the headline exactly: "Small cup. Big energy." Set this headline clearly and beautifully in the upper negative space in dark brown, clean readable typography. The headline must retain this exact capitalization and punctuation. Do not include any other text, lettering, logos, watermarks, signage or branding anywhere.
